name: YourPHRRecordOrigin
title: YourPHR record origin
description: How a record came to exist, where FHIR R4 has no standard code. Used in meta.tag.

concept.definition: The patient, or a personal device acting for them, is the source of this record, not a clinician. Whether a device was involved is said by Observation.device; Observation.performer names the patient. A document the patient uploads from a provider's portal is not PGHD.
Stated by the patient but incomplete or uncoded; kept, and left out of lists, counts, search and summaries until the patient resolves it.
